reviews.text:
If you're giving us a one-star rating because we're not answering calls, please redirect that rating to Hydro-Québec, which has cut off our power—and therefore our phone, internet, and electricity—since 10 p.m. last night. We no longer have access to our customer database and are struggling to inform owners that the clinic is unable to operate today, relying only on backups.

If you're giving us a one-star rating because we're not answering calls, please direct that rating to Hydro-Québec, which has cut off our power—and thus our phone, internet, and electricity—since 10 p.m. last night. We no longer have access to our customer database and are having a hard time using backups to inform owners that the clinic is unable to operate today.

My senior dog has a kidney problem that my local family vet wasn't able to manage (it was outside her area of ​​expertise), so she advised me to go to the DMV for internal medicine specialists who suggested at least five different tests. My cousin recommended the CVDVM for an abdominal ultrasound, and I was immediately grateful to have met Dr. Louvet. Calm, professional, and competent, he was able to accurately diagnose my dog ​​and propose the appropriate treatment. He didn't push for aggressive treatment and seems to genuinely care about the animal's well-being. Thank you again from Summer 🐶
Unfortunately, I liked them a lot initially, but I would never go back.

Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic in Montreal.
Dr. Duconseille and Dr. Louvet saved my cat, Toby, in 2024 by making a quick diagnosis that allowed for timely intervention. They have cared for all my animals with great love and professionalism. A clinic I recommend without hesitation!
So happy to have found this clinic for my little Suki, who has asthma! The team is lovely, caring, and truly attentive. I recommend them without hesitation! 🐾 …

I recommend this veterinarian without hesitation. She is simply exceptional. From the moment she meets Simba, she speaks to him with incredible gentleness, as if he were a baby, which immediately puts him at ease.

Beyond her skills, it's her immense compassion that makes all the difference. She always takes the time to answer all our questions, gives excellent advice, and you can tell she genuinely cares about her patients' well-being. You never feel rushed; she is fully present and attentive.

Thank you for your kindness, professionalism, and passion. Simba is in excellent hands, and we are truly grateful to have you as our veterinarian.
Excellent service

Excellent diagnosis, courteous, empathetic—Dr. Louvet is fantastic. Ultrasounds at very reasonable prices.
An address not to be missed.

After adopting our dog, we chose this veterinary clinic on a friend's recommendation, and we couldn't be happier with our choice.

How lucky we are to have such an exceptional team so close to home! The veterinarians, as well as all the staff, are incredibly kind, very attentive, and truly take the time to answer our questions. You can tell they genuinely care about the animals' well-being and always want what's best for them.
I recommend this clinic without hesitation!
Wonderful clinique, great vet!
Thank you Anastasiaa,  for your very sharing your positive experience

An absolutely fantastic team. This was my first visit today for an ultrasound for my cat, Hero. I loved Dr. Louvet and all the other members of his team—including Marc, the clinic's wonderful, very sociable cat who's quite the chatterbox and loves ear scratches. Top-notch professionalism. A comforting welcome during this very difficult time. My sincere gratitude.
Dr Louvet and staff are very kind, they take good care and give great advice for your pet family. We’re glad to have them in the Old Port

Simply the worst service I've ever received from a veterinary clinic. The receptionist and the veterinarian never returned my call regarding the follow-up for the neutering surgery scheduled on their calendar. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic due to their lack of professionalism. I suggest the Royal Vet clinic (Southwest) in Griffintown, which is less than 8 minutes from the Old Port on Notre-Dame Street. The staff is very accommodating and, above all, passionate about their work! In just one appointment, we had the blood tests done and a follow-up appointment scheduled in less than a week for his neutering surgery.

Terrible experience. They didn't respond to the appointment confirmation emails I sent two months ago, and then refused to neuter my dog. After I called two weeks prior to the appointment to confirm, they asked for a deposit, knowing I was out of town. The appointment has been scheduled for three months, and we've taken time off work. I absolutely do not recommend them given their complete lack of respect for their clients and their animals. I will go elsewhere.
Very compassionate and personal. Beautiful location.
Unreachable ‼️
Perfect.
Excellent service! We forgot our pee pads and the kind lady helped us out free of charge. Thank you!

I love this clinic, clean, spacious, doesn't have a cold feel as a clinic. Water fountain, toy decorations for IG. You can receive faster appointment and one-time services. What I like the most is my vet is not a pushy salesman even this clinic has been purchased by a bigger vet service chain brand.
Thank you Elizabeth, Griffin is an extraordinary companion whom we greatly appreciate, and we are proud and happy of the trust you place in us.
Thank you Fabricio for your very positive comment, we really appreciate

In response to the owners response: my review is based on my experience at your clinic. It has nothing to do with our professional relationship or the terrace. The fact you are trying to blame it on that is petty and just an excuse. Also, PLEASE stop sending me emails trying to intimidate me into removing my review. It is very unprofessional and unacceptable.
I have been to this vet a few times. Dr.Louvet is very kind and was great with my dog Max. However it's the first vet that when I asked how much they charge to clip nails I was told it would be $30 and I asked even with a consultation and they said yes. My other previous vets never charged for that service with a consultation. I received an estimate for the castration of my dog and was told I should get an ultrasound since one testicle hadnt dropped yet. The ultrasound was $200. Went to my old vet who felt around and could feel the other testicle and said I definitely don't need an ultrasound. They also didn't charge for the nail clipping. I will be continuing with my old vet.

Dr. Arnaud was thorough, explained what was necessary so I'm kept abreast of the health of my dogs, and most importantly, handled them with respect and care. He didn't try to upsell or squeeze every penny out of me, as many vets routinely do. I'm happy with them, so are my dogs.
I am so happy to have found such caring veterinarians who prioritize the well-being of animals, are competent, and attentive. I recommend them 100%!
great clinic.
I’ve always had excellent experiences with both veterinarians. They are highly competent, helpful, and professional.

Amazing staff and amazing place! They were such a help and support to me when I was taking my doggy back to the UK and needed to get the necessary health documents. Everyone here was so kind and genuine, and my anxious dog even loved the vet and took the tapeworm treatment from him without fuss! Can't recommend them enough. Just sad that I don't live in Montreal otherwise this would be our vet for sure.

Always an excellent experience at this clinic and had the pleasure of meeting several of the vets who care for our dogs

Both of my dogs are not ok with vet visits typically  but the staff are remarkable and so caring. We appreciate you! 🌸

Amazing vet & service  !! Got the appt asap! I got in with my little Sphynx because he got  urinary problem and did few tests. Did not get overcharged , vet explained everything, took his time! The vet was very gentle with Shanti! This will be our clinic from now on ! Thank you 🙏 …

I switched clinics to this one. I didn't think it was possible to find such a skilled vet. My dog ​​is a miniature dachshund, and in her 12 years of life, she's never "bitten" harder than a warning (she closed her mouth on my hand). However, as soon as another vet heard that, it was straight to the muzzle. This was incredibly counterproductive since there was no way she wouldn't panic (she once tore off a claw trying to remove a muzzle). This vet immediately understood that my dog ​​wasn't going to hurt her and performed the examination without sedation or a muzzle, demonstrating patience and empathy. I've never seen my dog ​​so calm during an exam. (She was terrified but let me do it.) I can't believe it. Bonus points for Mark, the cat at the entrance who provides emotional support to the dogs!

Years later, Karma, a dog who doesn't like many people (!!!), now loves her vet so much that she rushes to follow her as soon as she appears in the waiting room (even knowing what awaits her once she's on the examination table). It's incredible :')
Thank you so much Julien for your testimony, we are very touched.

I can’t say enough good things about this clinic. I bring both of my dogs, Gaia and Shanti, and every visit has been a great experience. The staff are always kind, welcoming, and patient — you can tell they truly care about the animals and their humans.

The vet is absolutely amazing. Knowledgeable, thorough, and compassionate. They take the time to explain everything clearly and never make you feel rushed or dismissed. I always leave feeling reassured and confident that Gaia and Shanti are in the best hands.

It’s such a relief to have a veterinary team I fully trust. Highly recommend.
Excellent veterinarian

We are so incredibly grateful to have found Dr. Louvet at Clinique Vétérinaire Du Vieux-Montréal.
When our Samoyed puppy, Diba, was only 8 weeks old, he became dangerously ill with vomiting and diarrhea. It was a terrifying situation for new pet parents, but Dr. Louvet literally saved Diba’s life. His swift, accurate diagnosis and immediate treatment had Diba recovered in less than a week.
Diba is now 6 months old and thriving, and we couldn’t be happier. Knowing we have such a competent, reliable, and caring veterinarian nearby gives us so much peace of mind. If you want the absolute best care for your furry family members, go see Dr. Louvet!

We have been going to this great clinic since it’s opening.  We’ve had dogs, currently Leo, for over 20 years now and can say Dr Louvet and Dr Duconseille are truly the best.  They are very receptive to our questions and their medical knowledge is impressive.  They take their time to really explain everything for you to understand the situation.  You can really feel that the well being of your animal is their top priority.  We highly recommend this clinic for its very competent veterinarians and staff and friendly atmosphere.

Four 1-star reviews have just been removed by Google. Here's a new one, born of Kyle Bourgeois' relentless attacks against us over the infamous collar incident: fake reviews, fake customers, never having been to Dr. Camille's clinic... pathetic.

Four 1-star reviews have just been removed by Google. Here is a new one, born of Kyle Bourgeois' relentless attacks against us over the famous story of the collar, fake reviews, fake customers, never having come to Dr. Camille's clinic... pathetic.
Thank you Laura, your comment is greatly appreciated

Highly recommend, service is always great! I’ve been visiting this clinic for the past 3 years and I’m always happy with the care my cat has received. Most of my appointments were with Dr. Louvet and he’s very knowledgeable and kind. Also recommend Dr. Duconseille and Dr. Gombert who have seen my cat as well. Thank you for taking seriously my cat’s health and wellbeing! :)
Bad experience... very disappointed... I could never trust them again 👎 …

An absolutely, positively shockingly terrible experience with the alleged owner of this clinic. I'll note that I sincerely question whether or not he has a substance abuse problem and the safety of animals in his care as a result of this.

Background: My 1 year old cat came to be sprayed. Everything proceeded normally and she was returned home the same day (so far, excellent!). Within 15 minutes of being home however, the cone that they put on her following the surgery came off by itself. I contact them to advise, noting that I am a little irate over the situation as the cat had done very little since her return and it seemed to not be properly put on resulting in it coming off as quickly as it did. They recommend that I return to place it back on and verify ASAP and so I return once more. I'll note here that they do not provide me any concerns relating to the timeline, simply that I should come as soon as possible (this will be more relevant later).

Upon arriving back at the clinic less than 30 minutes later, the vet places the cone back on her and notes that the cone may be too large for her however they do not have any in my cat's size, which is what might have contributed to it falling off so easily. I find this relatively silly as they had my cat's size based on the fact that I came in <3 months ago and the appointment has been scheduled for some time, ergo having a cone of her size should have been relatively easy to be prepared for. The vet notes that they also have pajama's but is worried that they do not have them in my cat's small size either (I don't say anything again relating to how frustrating this is). I advise that I do have a friend that has a pajama from his cat who is the same size as my cat and the vet advises me that if I contact my friend they can have him come bring the pajama and verify to ensure that it fits properly (again, no concerns relating to timelines is given here).

Okay, no problem -- I call my aforementioned friend (in front of the vet) and he agrees to come. This is where the situation takes a turn for the worse. 10 minutes later, I advise the same vet that my friend is 15 minutes away and she notes that they are unable to stay longer than 15 minutes. At this stage, I do not say anything as the experience has been quite poor but fine, I get it, they're busy. 5 minutes after this, the alleged owner (more on this) comes and states that they cannot wait 25 minutes for my friend to arrive and will try on the pajama that does not fit instead. I attempt to advise him that I'm not certain why he is saying 25 minutes when I had advised that he was less than 15 minutes away 5 minutes ago however the gentleman does not seem interested in listening.

As the other vet is getting the wrong sized pajama, I politely inform the gentleman that I would like to make a complaint and would appreciate if I were provided the contact details of the most responsible individual. He laughs and says that he is the owner and that my complaint is unfounded (despite the fact that he does not take any time to listen to the multiple concerns). It is at this time that I notice that he does not appear to be 'all there'. During this time, the vet has returned and is doing her best to put the pajama's on, clearly noting that she is concerned with the size fitting. The owner brushes her feedback off and says that it'll do.  I note once more that this service has been quite poor and that I will be placing a complaint, to which the owner advises that I am now 'threatening him'.

As I am leaving, I took a picture and video outside the building to be used with this post. The owner was in the window (picture included) and he quite literally fell over himself while walking, perhaps intoxicated on lord knows what substance (as noted above, there were multiple concerns and physical cues that seem to indicate that he was on something). This is neither an exaggeration nor someone acting normally but rather clearly someone who there are legitimate concerns with leaving your pets with. Beware.
We adore these vets ❤️

I wanted to say a big thank you to Dr. Louvet. It’s thanks to his care, attention, and immense medical knowledge that my cat Plusha is living and thriving.
Our cat was feeling really bad recently, stopped eating, and lost a lot of weight. We were directed to this clinic to do an ultrasound. Dr. Louvet scheduled us as soon as it was possible, and during just one consultation covered all the possible solutions, reasons and diagnosis. He took all the necessary tests there on spot, and in 3 days we already started the treatment.
I’m forever grateful to Dr. Louvet for saving Plusha’s life.
Thank you François for your testimony
Thank you Ian for sharing your positive experience

I have been to Clinique Veterinary du Vieux-Montreal twice for ultrasounds for my cat Coco and was impressed both times with the service and friendly staff. Dr. Louvet takes his time to explain everything and puts you at ease.

This is the first experience I had with a vet clinic in Montreal, and it was a great one.
My cat is very easygoing and felt at home in the clinic. Dr Louvet is such a gentle person and you can sense his calmness from across the room. I really recommend it !

Dr. Duconseille is a veterinarian who truly takes the time to examine animals and answer all our questions. You can tell that the well-being of animals is her priority. She doesn't push unnecessary expenses and is honest about the tests. She offers excellent advice, is professional and friendly, and can get you an appointment quickly!

Who are you? There is no record of you in our files. What is the name of your pet? What happened? This helps readers understand your arguments and helps us understand what disappointed you at the clinic.

Very bad experience with this clinic.

In November 2024, I consulted for a dental cleaning for my dog ​​(2 and a half years old). I was given an estimate, which was stated to be valid for one year, and asked to call back in January, as the veterinarian was expecting a specific tool for tooth extraction.

• In January, I was informed that the tool still hadn't arrived.

• At the beginning of summer, it was still impossible to get an appointment without a clear explanation.

• In August, I was told that the veterinarian was on vacation for a month and that I would have to call back. I asked to be called back, but was told that it wasn't possible.

• Today, after a fourth call, I'm told that I have to pay for another consultation because "it's been a long time," even though it's September and the estimate is still valid for a year. Finally, the receptionist left me on hold and never got back on the line, nor did she ever call back.

As a result, I still haven't been able to get an appointment.

👉 The veterinarian (Dr. Peter) was very friendly during the initial consultation, but the customer service and appointment management are simply appalling. A big 0/10.

Avoid this clinic.

RESPONSE TO THEIR COMMENT: In fact, when I asked if I would have to pay for another consultation, they clearly stated that I would. Furthermore, it's not a question of "eleven months later," since I tried four times to get an appointment for my dog's teeth cleaning, and it's your delays that have dragged things out. In reality, it's been ten months.

I even had an appointment in January, but unfortunately, it was lost in your system—again, due to your lack of management and organization.

I find it quite ironic that your clinic tries to blame clients who leave negative reviews for misunderstandings, absolving you of responsibility every time.

Just yesterday, the receptionist left me on hold and never returned my call. I received no response, just like every time I've had to contact you. This is the first time I've ever seen a company fail to follow up with its clients.

Lack of management, organization, and especially customer service.
The veterinarians and technicians were professional and friendly. They provided helpful explanations during the ultrasound procedure. Thank you all.
They are simply the best in Quebec. I can't thank you enough for being there and upholding your ethical values. ❤️ Miria says thank you and she's doing wonderfully.
Thank you on behalf of the entire team, Mélanie, for sharing your positive feedback.

Top-notch veterinary clinic!

Superb welcome, the staff is very pleasant. The veterinarian who saw me was attentive, kind, and very helpful with my cat.

The prices are really reasonable for such good service. (I've tried several in Montreal.) I highly recommend it!

Excellent service. Professionalism and courtesy were evident. Ino and I received outstanding service. Honorable mention to Marc, who oversees the premises. Don't hesitate to entrust them with your treasures.
Very clean and professional. They were so kind to work with and explained everything very directly and well. I'm very happy with our visit there!!
Thank you Pierre for your very positive review

A huge thank you to this clinic, which saw my dog ​​the same day for a paw injury, while my usual vet had a week and a half wait. The vet was very competent, attentive to my dog's needs, and warm. The best experience I've had since moving to Quebec three years ago. Especially since the prices are reasonable.

I cannot recommend this veterinary practice enough. Dr. Louvet is always so kind and patient with our two French bulldogs, who’ve visited the clinic for various concerns over the past year (neutering / scratched eyeball). You can really tell that all of the staff deeply care about animals, and we know they always have their best interest at heart. Thank you!

Dr. Louvet is amazing! We came in for an Ultrasound. He took such great care of Bandit and made the whole experience way less stressful than I expected.

You can tell he really knows his stuff and actually cares. He explained everything in a way that made sense and didn’t rush through anything. Super grateful for him and the team at Clinique Vétérinaire du Vieux-Montréal. Definitely recommend!

Great staff. The veterinarian took time with my cat and I didn't have to wait.
They cut her nails and the échographie was at a reasonable price. They are very nice. I love this place and my cat 🐈 too 😻 …

A wonderful experience with my cat Baileys, who is naturally anxious. The vet was gentle and respectful. I found him honest and didn't feel he was trying to make a quick buck. The price was very reasonable for the complete visit. I highly recommend him!
Thank you so much for your very positive review.

Dr. Louvet is so kind, gentle and patient. He made a difficult situation a bit more tolerable.
Give yourself time to find parking but well worth it. Thank you to his team.

Recently moved to the city and just chose this vet after reading the reviews. The vets and staff are amazing. They are incredibly kind, gentle and understanding. I have a very reactive dog who is scared of men and he was completely calm and unafraid. It was a huge stress taken off my shoulders. I can’t recommend this clinic enough.

We've been to multiple vets over the years, but this one is by far the best in terms of both service and pricing. Our two dogs, Shyloh and Buster, recently had to go through major surgeries, and we were super happy with the care they received. Dr. Arnaud Louvet is hands down the most caring and attentive vet we've ever had. Not only did he take the time to explain everything to us before the surgeries, but he even reached out the night after the procedure to check on our dog’s recovery.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate veterinary clinic!
Kind doctors. They made my dog feel at ease. Very professional and well equipped clinic. Prices are fair.
Thanks a lot Bagha for your very positive review, very appreciated
Zoe and her dad will always be welcome at the clinic, thank you so much for your positive feedback.
The best vets 😻😻😻 …

A small clinic with a big heart, professional insight, and a cheerful spirit, where every animal is treated as if it were the only patient.

Among the clinic's strengths are quick and accurate diagnosis, targeted and carefully tailored treatment, attentive and warm communication, and remarkable integrity. Finally, the prices are more than affordable.
My cat, who was extremely anemic and on the verge of cardiac arrest due to a missed diagnosis elsewhere, was quickly diagnosed by Dr. Louvet and then closely monitored with adjusted treatments, to the point where she is now thriving. Dr. Louvet also stands out for her exceptional gentleness in interacting with animals, so that even the most fearful feel reassured.
As a pet owner with extensive experience with veterinary clinics, I recommend this clinic 100%. Look no further—you won't find better.

A huge thank you to Dr. Louvet and the entire team!

P.S. The attached photos show the cat's condition upon arrival at the clinic in 2023, her condition 6 months later (red coat) and finally the current photo (grey beret).
The entire team thanks you, Margaux, for your very positive feedback; thank you for your trust.

I took my kitten  to this clinic for spaying, and the surgery was performed by Dr. Peter.
Unfortunately, our experience was not a positive one. After the operation, my cat felt very unwell and took a long time to recover. The incision on her belly looked poorly done, and after the intubation, she developed breathing issues that persist to this day ((

I highly recommend carefully choosing a veterinary clinic and a surgeon, relying not only on appearance but also on real reviews and the experiences of other pet owners. I hope my review helps others make an informed decision.

I had an awesome experience at this vet clinic! My dog is usually very nervous, but the team went above and beyond to ensure it was a positive visit. They were incredibly patient, taking all the necessary time to help my dog feel comfortable. Communication was excellent throughout the visit, which I really appreciated.

The clinic is in a great location and has a welcoming atmosphere. Dre Anne-Carole is amazing—her care and professionalism really stood out. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back!

Thank you :)
Thank you Maude for your valuable feedback, with a special mention for Boubou who is a super cat!

INCREDIBLE EXPERIENCE , INCREDIBLE STAFF , special thank to Doctor Peter GOMBERG, Doctor Arnaud LOUVET for their exceptional service and the receptionist for being so patient and answering my 10000 questions
I can't recommend them enough!
The veterinarians are knowledgeable and genuinely care about the animals they treat.

The clinic is clean and well organized, and you can tell they prioritize the well being of their patients. and the follow up care has been exceptional and very impressive.
It's clear that they are passionate about what they do and are committed to providing the best care possible.

If you're looking for a reliable and compassionate veterinary clinic, and veterinarians that actually care about your pet and won't overcharge you for unnecessary diagnoses, look no further than this clinic . I’m so grateful for the care my dog and my cat received and I will definitely be returning for all our future needs 🫶

I visited the clinic today for the first time with my senior dog Teddy and had such a wonderful experience! Dr. Arnaud Louvet was so caring, kind and extremely knowledgeable. This is the first time that I did not feel rushed during the consultation and was able to discuss all of my concerns. I also was able to have an x-ray done for my dog which was so convenient. Dr Louvet took the time to sit with me after and explain the images which was very reassuring. This is by far the best vet I have found and you will be in very good hands here! You can tell that Dr. Louvet has a lot of experience plus I appreciate his calm and friendly attitude. The prices were very fair and actually less than I was quoted at other clinics. Also want to mention the lovely receptionist who was super friendly and fun to chat with. And the office cat is very cute 🥰

I am so grateful to find this place! If you want the absolute best care for your animal this is the place to go. Thank you Dr. Louvet and team! ❤️
Excellent service, clean place. The staff were very friendly and knowledgeable about the treatments.
Thank you very much Arthur, it's always a pleasure to welcome Ditee for a consultation, wishing her an excellent 2025
Best veterinary clinic in Montreal. They are passionate, patient, very gentle, and attentive! Plus, their prices are super affordable. I recommend them 100%!
The warmest and friendliest veterinary clinic!
Thank you very much for your positive assessment and your good experience at the clinic with little Lucious.
Thank you Kamilia for your review, we are very happy to count Maddy among our new patients, she is so charming

I was told to go see Dr. Louvet for an ultrasound for my dog who was not doing well. After a visit at the ER, I was told I needed this exam to determine the condition of my beautiful dog Madison. Upon our arrival the staff was friendly and once Dr. Louvet came to escort us to the exam room I could tell he was a gentile, caring Dr. He explained everything so compassionately. He made me feel at ease and did everything in his power to make what would soon occur as human and with dignity. Unfortunately, my sweet girl was at the end of her time. I had to euthanize her. Dr. Louvre took time to explain what had happened to my girl and answered all of our questions. He kept Madison at his office till the rest of the family could join one last goodbye.

I have this to say, if you need to see  Dr. Louvet do it without hesitation. A true professional , compassionate, gentile dr with a kind touch to make any pet owners feel completely comfortable and happy knowing they are doing what is best for their fur baby. Thank you Dr. Louvet. I am devastated at Madison’s loss but happy that I have found a wonderful vet.
Thank you for your positive comment, it means a lot to us.
Nice service. Good veterinarian. Nice place.
It's a shame the hours are the same as office hours, otherwise they are competent people.

Sadly our first time visiting Griffes in Town was when our cat was extremely sick at the end of her life, with an illness that hadn't been caught by our previous vet. Dr Lovet at Griffes in Town caught her illness immediately once the appointment started, before he had even done the ultrasound. I wonder if we had used Griffes in Town earlier as our regular vet if we would have been able to do something for our cat.

That aside, our cat had always been terrified of the vet, and would freak out when they tried to pick her up, draw blood, or take her temperature. But with Dr Louvet she was so calm, even when she was having her temperature taken and an injection. It really speaks to his ability and expertise that not only was our cat calm in his presence but that he was able to correctly identify her health issue almost immediately.

Even in her final moments, a week later at the same vet, we felt soothed knowing that she was comfortable at this vet. The staff handled the situation so gently. The experience went as well as it possibly could, given the situation. Also a shout-out to the receptionist, who recognized us from the one visit we had had before, and checked us in for the final euthanasia appointment with just a nod when we walked in the door without us having to stand there with him.

I really truly cannot recommend this vet enough. Without a shadow of a doubt they will become our regular vet. They were available to help us at short notice in a time of need, and the vet could not have been better.

Excellent veterinary clinic that I recommend 100%!

I came for a routine check-up for my cat. The welcome was warm, and the care …
